notes.title: Update Notes for March 23rd.
notes.content:
We’ve been listening to your extremely helpful feedback and thought it was about time for another update with a few simple but important quality-of-life improvements, as well as a pretty big addition to our puzzle generation modes.

Quality of Life:
- Undo has been added!
- Before, you could not access the options menu until after completing the tutorial. Now it’s how it should have been all along, you can change settings as soon as you load into the game.
- We have switched from toggle-based volume settings to a much more flexible slider-based approach, so you can tune your audio to fit your setup and all of your settings will of course be saved.
- A few minor bug fixes.

Clarity
- We have updated the descriptions of our difficulty modes that more accurately explain what you are getting with each mode. Since Duplicado puzzles are generated procedurally we want players to understand that sometimes a hard difficulty might generate a puzzle that you find surprisingly easy, and vice versa. just one of the quirks of the orchard!

New Puzzle Mode!
- We have heard from you that the hardest puzzles are the best puzzles, and due to the procedural generation those puzzles were too few and far between, so we decided to add a completely new mode that has a much higher chance of generating those really tough puzzles. It’s called the 'Seeds Only' mode, and it will unlock alongside the Challenge mode so most of you will have instant access to it. This mode generates puzzles with a seed-only piece set, which tend to be much harder to solve!

We already have some great ideas for new features and future updates, thank you all again so much for playing and providing feedback we really appreciate it.

notes.title: Update Notes for March 3
notes.content:
Removed some debug actions that shouldn't have been there. Oops!
We've gotten some feedback that more hotkeys could be useful, so we added them for all the major actions and menus!


If you encounter any bugs, please let us know in the community hub.
Enjoy!

notes.title: Update notes for Feb 3
notes.content:

Keys generated in this version onwards should work correctly.
